**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The Agreement's only pricing-parity commitment runs in our favour. In § 6 (Documentation and Disputes, p0047), TrueLink undertakes that Hosting Services costs will not increase for one year and that "rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party" — a Vendor-granted MFN benefiting us as Client.

I checked the Compensation section, the Client covenants and warranties section (the likely home of any customer-side undertaking), and ran full-text searches for MFN formulations ("most favored", "favorable", "no less favorable", "best", "terms offered", "any other party", "third party"). Nothing obliges Mortgage Logic.com to give TrueLink terms no less favourable than those offered to third parties or to match competing offers, so the playbook's preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer, Vendor-granted MFN retained) is already satisfied.
